extDesc.message: Open-source, privacy-first bilingual web translation with PDF support (layout kept, translated text selectable). Free engines built in, BYOK supported, every request goes straight from your browser — no middle server, no data collection.

popupHover.message: Hover translation (hold Alt over a paragraph)

popupShortcuts.message: Shortcuts: <kbd>Alt+T</kbd>/<kbd>Alt+A</kbd> translate or restore the page · <kbd>Alt+W</kbd> translate the whole page · <kbd>Alt+Enter</kbd> in a text field writes it in another language

popupNothingTranslated.message: Nothing on this page was translated

optAccountHint.message: The AI tiers (Standard / Premium) draw on your account balance on the website; the free Google tier needs no account. Log in or out on the website, then press Refresh status — the extension never stores your password.

optTargetLangHint.message: 199 languages, each one tested end to end. The most common ones also appear in the popup.

optDisplayHint.message: In translation-only mode the original is merely hidden — "Show original" brings all of it back.

optHoverDesc.message: Hold the trigger key and move the mouse over a paragraph to translate it

optSelectionDesc.message: Select any text and a translation bubble appears

optInputDesc.message: Press Alt+Enter in a text field to turn what you wrote into the language selected here

optShortcutsHint.message: Shortcuts: Alt+T or Alt+A translate/restore the page · Alt+W translate the page again including new content · select text to translate it · Alt+Enter in a text field writes it in another language · hover the floating button for the quick menu

optEngineLibre.message: LibreTranslate (open source, needs an instance URL)

optEngineAiGroup.message: AI tiers (uses your website balance, no key needed)

optEngineKeyGroup.message: High-quality engines (bring your own API key)

optEngineHint.message: Free Google is the default and is enough for everyday reading; if it is rate-limited the extension falls back to Microsoft on its own. The AI tiers spend credits from your website account — log in there in this browser and they work here (the extension stores no credentials). You can also bring your own API key for the engines below.

optDeepLHint.message: Register free at deepl.com; a key ending in ":fx" is a free one.

optDeepSeekHint.message: Get one at platform.deepseek.com — around $0.001 per thousand characters.

optOpenAIHint.message: Get one at platform.openai.com; uses gpt-4o-mini.

optLibreHint.message: Open source and self-hostable, the most private option. See LibreTranslate.

optMaskDesc.message: Mask emails, phone numbers, card and ID numbers and API keys locally before sending, then restore them in the translation

optMaskHint.message: Detection and restoration happen entirely in your browser; the sensitive original never reaches a translation provider. In rare cases an engine rewrites a placeholder and that one spot cannot be restored (nothing leaks) — switch this off if you hit that.

optPdfHint.message: Whole PDFs with the layout preserved (including academic formulas) are translated on the website: pdf.openimmersive.ai →

optFileHint.message: Supports .srt .ass .html .txt .md: parsed locally, only the words are sent for translation, and timecodes, tags and code blocks are left exactly as they were. For PDF, Word and other layout-heavy documents use the online document translator.

optPrivacyBody.message: Every translation request goes straight from your browser to the translation provider — no middle server, no proxy, no data collection. API keys stay on this device. The code is open source and auditable.

optAcctSoon.message: The AI tiers are coming to the extension soon (the free Google tier is unaffected)

optAcctSignedOut.message: Not signed in — press "Log in / Sign up", finish on the website, then come back and refresh

fileNoTranslation.message: the engine returned no translation at all

filePartial.message: Done ($FAILED$/$TOTAL$ segments kept their original text: $ERROR$)

fileEmptyResult.message: the engine returned an empty translation

errLoginRequired.message: Log in at $SITE$ to use the AI tiers (the free Google tier needs no account)

errOutOfCredits.message: Out of credits — top up or subscribe at $SITE$

errAiSoon.message: The AI tiers are not available in the extension yet — please use the free Google tier for now

errNeedDeepLKey.message: Add a DeepL API key in settings (the free tier covers 500K characters a month)

errNeedOpenAIKey.message: Add an OpenAI API key in settings

errNeedDeepSeekKey.message: Add a DeepSeek API key in settings

welcomeLead.message: Installed. Three steps and you know the daily workflow — privacy first, nothing routed through a middle server.

welcomeStep1Body.message: Open any page in another language and press <kbd>Alt+T</kbd>, or click "Translate this page" in the toolbar popup. The translation appears under each paragraph; press again to restore the original.

welcomeStep2Body.message: Not the whole page? Hold <kbd>Alt</kbd> and move the mouse over a paragraph to translate just that one. The trigger key can be changed to Ctrl or Shift in settings.

welcomeStep3.message: Selection translation & writing in another language

welcomeStep3Body.message: Select any text and a translation bubble pops up. Writing an email in another language? Type it in your own language in the text field and press <kbd>Alt+Enter</kbd> to translate it in place (target language is configurable in settings).

welcomeTipPin.message: 💡 Pin the extension to the toolbar (puzzle icon at the top right of the browser → pin) — it is much handier that way.

welcomeEngines.message: Free engines by default, zero configuration. For higher quality, configure DeepL and others under More settings → Advanced.

extDescShort.message: Open-source, privacy-first bilingual translation: whole page, selection, hover and text fields, 199 languages. No middle server.

uiLocale.description: Which language this catalogue is written in; language names follow it.
